purpose.description: RTT Inside Enterprise is the Enterprise-domain deployment context for the RTT engine stack. It provides domain-native signal labels, regime vocabulary, and translation tables mapping abstract RTT signals to Enterprise-specific constructs: structural faultlines → org-structure fractures; drift vectors → capital migration and labor displacement velocity; substrate capacity → infrastructure runway and budget headroom; coherence → cross-functional integration quality; DRM → enterprise-wide interdependency resonance map. The Enterprise context is consumed by the Domain Overlay to produce Enterprise-flavoured DDRs, DAMs, and CDCSs.
